services:
  web:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL:?NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL is required}
        NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3020:3000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URI=mongodb://mongo:27017/urban_kit
      - PAYLOAD_SECRET=${PAYLOAD_SECRET:?PAYLOAD_SECRET is required}
      - NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
      # Both serving domains — Payload's CSRF allowlist (payload.config.ts)
      # must trust cookie-authenticated requests from either origin.
      - NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=${NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_DOMAIN:-urbankit.de}
      - NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_DOMAIN=${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_DOMAIN:-app.urbankit.de}
      - SMTP_HOST=${SMTP_HOST:-localhost}
      - SMTP_PORT=${SMTP_PORT:-1025}
      - METHODEN_URL=${METHODEN_URL:-https://methoden.urbankit.de}
      - METHODEN_API_KEY=${METHODEN_API_KEY:-}
      # Password for the seeded prototype accounts (seed:prototype / rotate script)
      - SEED_USERS_PASSWORD=${SEED_USERS_PASSWORD:-}
      # Urban Agent (AI) — provider selection + keys; all optional, the module
      # shows "nicht konfiguriert" without any of them (see docs/env-reference.md)
      - URBAN_AGENT_PROVIDER=${URBAN_AGENT_PROVIDER:-}
      - URBAN_AGENT_MODEL=${URBAN_AGENT_MODEL:-}
      - URBAN_AGENT_DAILY_MAX=${URBAN_AGENT_DAILY_MAX:-}
      - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      - MISTRAL_API_KEY=${MISTRAL_API_KEY:-}
      - OLLAMA_BASE_URL=${OLLAMA_BASE_URL:-}
      - OLLAMA_MODEL=${OLLAMA_MODEL:-}
    volumes:
      - media_data:/app/media
      # Project document uploads (file-uploads collection, staticDir uploads/files)
      # — without this volume they are destroyed on every container rebuild.
      - uploads_data:/app/uploads
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # busybox wget — the Alpine runner image ships no curl
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 20s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    networks:
      - urban_kit
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1g

  hocuspocus:
    build:
      context: ./hocuspocus
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      - PORT=1234
      # Full-stack compose: the web container. Mixed dev (Next on the host,
      # sidecar in Docker): set HOCUSPOCUS_PAYLOAD_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000
      # in .env — with the default, room authorization fails (no `web` host)
      # and the board silently loses all realtime.
      - PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL=${HOCUSPOCUS_PAYLOAD_URL:-http://web:3000}
      - HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=${HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET:?HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET is required}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:1234:1234"
    depends_on:
      - web
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - urban_kit
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m

  # Dev mailcatcher: receives all transactional mail (activation links etc.)
  # on :1025 and shows it at http://localhost:8025 — SMTP_HOST defaults
  # target it. Production points SMTP_* at a real provider instead.
  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:1025:1025"
      - "127.0.0.1:8025:8025"
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - urban_kit
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m

  mongo:
    image: mongo:7
    volumes:
      - mongo_data:/data/db
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:27019:27017"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "--eval", "db.adminCommand('ping')"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - urban_kit
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m


networks:
  urban_kit:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  mongo_data:
  media_data:
  uploads_data:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Johannes Homann
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: EUPL-1.2

# Production override for docker-compose.yml — same pattern as the
# urban-kit-methodensammlung stack.
#
# Deploy on the VPS with:
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
#
# Assumptions (chosen for this setup):
#   - TLS is terminated by an EXTERNAL reverse proxy already running on the host
#     (nginx/Caddy/Traefik). The base compose already binds web (127.0.0.1:3020)
#     and the board websocket (127.0.0.1:1234) to loopback only — the proxy
#     forwards urbankit.de/app.urbankit.de to :3020 and wss to :1234.
#   - MongoDB runs in this stack with root authentication enabled.
#   - Transactional mail goes to a real SMTP provider (SMTP_* in .env); the
#     mailpit dev catcher is parked behind a compose profile and never starts.
#
# Reads its values from the project .env file (Compose auto-loads it).
# Set at least: MONGO_ROOT_USER, MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD (plus the base-compose
# requirements PAYLOAD_SECRET, HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_*).

services:
  web:
    restart: always
    environment:
      # Same key as the base file — later files win, so this swaps the
      # unauthenticated URI for the credentialed one.
      - DATABASE_URI=mongodb://${MONGO_ROOT_USER:?set MONGO_ROOT_USER in .env}:${MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}@mongo:27017/urban_kit?authSource=admin

  hocuspocus:
    restart: always

  # Dev mailcatcher — parked behind a profile so it does not start in prod
  # (profiles only run when explicitly requested).
  mailpit:
    profiles: ["dev-mail"]

  mongo:
    # Do not publish Mongo at all in prod; only services on the compose
    # network talk to it.
    ports: !reset []
    restart: always
    environment:
      # First-boot creates this root user. NOTE: only applied on an EMPTY data
      # volume — for an existing mongo_data volume create the user manually
      # (see docs/deployment.md).
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: ${MONGO_ROOT_USER:?set MONGO_ROOT_USER in .env}
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
# Database
DATABASE_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/urban_kit

# MongoDB root auth — PROD ONLY (docker-compose.prod.yml). First boot on an
# empty volume creates this user; web then connects with these credentials.
MONGO_ROOT_USER=urbankit
MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD=change-me-to-a-long-random-string

# Password for the seeded prototype accounts (seed:prototype). REQUIRED in
# prod — without it the roster gets the public dev password demo1234, and the
# account emails are visible in this repo. Rotate later with
# scripts/rotate-seed-passwords.ts.
SEED_USERS_PASSWORD=

# Payload
PAYLOAD_SECRET=change-me-to-a-long-random-string

# SMTP
SMTP_HOST=localhost
SMTP_PORT=1025
SMTP_USER=
SMTP_PASS=
SMTP_FROM=noreply@urbankit.de

# Domains
NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=urbankit.de
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_DOMAIN=app.urbankit.de
NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000

# AI — Urban Agent. Provider is chosen in the admin (Einstellungen → Urban
# Agent) or via URBAN_AGENT_PROVIDER; with neither set, the first key found
# below wins (Anthropic → OpenAI → Mistral → Ollama). No cross-provider
# failover.
# URBAN_AGENT_PROVIDER=mistral
# URBAN_AGENT_MODEL=
# MISTRAL_API_KEY=
# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
# OPENAI_API_KEY=
# OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434
# OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3
# Global daily request ceiling across all users (cost backstop)
# URBAN_AGENT_DAILY_MAX=600

# Methodensammlung (optional — method teasers on Bereich Grundlagen)
# API-client key from the Methodensammlung admin (API Clients collection);
# without it the page simply shows no teasers.
METHODEN_URL=https://methoden.urbankit.de
# METHODEN_API_KEY=

# Hocuspocus (realtime sidecar for Board)
HOCUSPOCUS_URL=ws://localhost:1234
HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=change-me-hocuspocus-secret
# Browser-facing WS URL for the board client (public; use wss:// in production)
NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL=ws://localhost:1234
# Where the sidecar reaches Payload for auth + persistence (compose: http://web:3000)
PAYLOAD_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:3000
